paragraphs: Your team is delivering actionable insights and building data-driven solutions across EDITED. That is the kind of problem I have been working on. I check the data before I trust a model: I audited 859,494 training examples and found 44,369 duplicates, and for my AstraZeneca-affiliated MSc dissertation I combined 14 research datasets so the results rested on trusted data. When my gene models scored 0.807 on training data but only 0.545 on new data, I reported it plainly instead of hiding it.

I placed 3rd at Lloyd's Banking Group's datathon by spotting rare suspicious transactions, about 1 in 200, and in my MSc I used proper statistics, planning the sample size first and then running ANOVA tests, to pick the best of 6 algorithm settings. At 180 Degrees Consulting I helped turn a startup's vague idea into a working tool that is now in live, day-to-day use; the client's founder called it "stable, production-ready". I also built a model that predicts which bank customers are likely to leave, and I have presented results to the client's stakeholders in a live demo.
Your ad's focus on data science models and pipelines is a big part of why I am applying.
Could we spend 20 minutes on how the team integrates data products into production systems?

experience.title: Data Scientist, MSc Dissertation Project
experience.situation: Needed an LLM a research team could trust before it shipped
bullets: Did the data analysis on 14 research datasets and combined them so the assistant only used trusted data, then put it online on AWS (Python, AWS Lambda).
Built a generative AI assistant researchers could trust: it checks gene names against official databases and falls back to a local list of 19,213 genes if they go down (LangChain, AWS).

Studied graph neural network research and designed how genes and cell lines are linked in one graph, with clustering to find similar ones (Leiden, KNN).
